name: Kolkheti National Park
story: Kolkheti National Park is located in western Georgia on a coastal plain on the Black Sea. Established between 1998 and 1999, it covers an area of 28,940 hectares. It protects unique forests, wetlands, and a high number of threatened species.
matters: The wetlands of Central Kolkheti are a Wetland of International Importance and a Ramsar Site. Because of its unique forests, wetlands, and threatened species, the park was inscribed on the UNESCO World Heritage List as part of the Colchic Rainforests and Wetlands site in 2021.
